facts.text: Lake Norman was named after former Duke Power president Norman Atwater Cocke, honoring his role in the lake’s creation.
The construction of Interstate 77 in the mid‑1970s made Lake Norman a weekend getaway for Charlotte residents, sparking a boom in homes and recreation.
Lake Norman consistently ranks among the cleanest lakes in the Catawba chain, with water quality tests showing no violations of local standards.
For building permits, code enforcement, or inspections, residents of Norman can contact the town hall or Richmond County authorities directly.
Lake Norman’s shoreline once hosted historic mill towns whose homes were moved to avoid flooding when the lake was filled in the 1950s.
